item.title: Dotcomedian.com (a social network)
item.description: Dotcomedian.com (a social network) [2026] is an ironic work of art that invites viewers to contemplate and practically experience what a social network is and what the physical forms of its infrastructure can look like. The work presents the viewer with a social network literally glued to the wall right before their eyes, while also being accessible online on their smartphone at the domain specified in its title: dotcomedian.com. It thus creates a contrast between the widespread perception of a social network as a massive Moloch and a low-tech implementation running on a more than 10-year-old BananaPi M1+ single-board computer worth 12 euros.

item.title: Sauna / What Dean Promised I am Doing
item.description: As part of pre-election promises for both terms the current dean of Faculty of Fine Arts promised a school sauna for students and employees of faculty. However this populist promise was never realized. To react I took his promise seriously and tried my best… Sauna was operating from January 2017 to March 2017, freely open to all students, employees and visitors of faculty.
